verses.text: For the one directing. [To] “Do not Destroy.” Of David. A Miktam in his fleeing from the face of Saul in the cave. Have mercy on me, O God, have mercy on me! For in You my soul takes refuge, and in the shadow of Your wings I will make my refuge, until the calamities have passed by.

verses.text: I will call out to El-Elyon, to God, who fulfills for me.

segments.text: I will call out to El-Elyon, to God, who fulfills for me.

verses.text: He sends forth from the heavens, and saves me; He rebukes the one panting after me. Selah God sends forth His loving devotion and His faithfulness.

verses.text: My soul [is] in the midst of lions; I lie down [among] flames—the sons of men, their teeth [are] spears and arrows, and their tongue [is] a sharp sword.

verses.text: Be exalted above the heavens, O God, Your glory above all the earth!

segments.text: Be exalted above the heavens, O God, Your glory above all the earth!

verses.text: They have prepared a net for my steps; my soul is bent down; they have dug before me a pit—may they fall into its midst! Selah

verses.text: Awake, my glory! Awake, O harp and lyre—I will awaken the dawn!

verses.text: I will confess You among the peoples, O Lord; I will make music to You among the nations.

verses.text: For Your loving devotion reaches to the heavens, and Your faithfulness to the clouds.

verses.text: [Be] lifted high above the heavens, O God, [and] above all the earth Your glory!
